law: docs/DATA-PLANE-PLACEMENT.md (RATIFIED, operator plan statement trace 1a168885359acda1): identity + courses + learner model = main; ALL corpus data = warehouse fleet; no new corpus plane in main — a new content table family is assigned its warehouse home at design time or DEFERRED.
docs/ADR-038 (same ratification): one Neon account, course-group warehouse projects, frozen template provisioned by script, no migrations per warehouse, ever.
docs/DATA-PLANE-PLACEMENT.md §4.1 seam law: ids are the contract; NO cross-project FKs.
